mainTopic: Who cannot collect from שבח or ראוי (the בכור, the כתובה, daughters' מזונות, and the יבם), the sources for each, and the dispute between אביי and רבא about the יבם.
overview: This amud finishes the משנה. The משנה says that a wife collecting her כתובה, daughters collecting their מזונות, and a יבם all share the בכור's limit: none of them takes from the שבח (value that grew after the death) or from ראוי (money owed to the dead man but not yet collected). The גמרא gives verses for the בכור's limits. "ולו משפט הבכורה" teaches that there is no double portion from a mother's estate. "בכל אשר ימצא לו" teaches that there is no double portion of שבח or ראוי. The גמרא then challenges the כתובה rule with שמואל's ruling that a בעל חוב does collect from שבח. רבי אבא answers that this is one of the special leniencies of the כתובה. The daughters' מזונות follow the same rule, because a תנאי כתובה is treated like the כתובה itself. The יבם is excluded because the Torah calls him a בכור. אביי and רבא then disagree about growth between the יבום and the division of the estate: אביי says the יבם takes it, and רבא says he does not. The amud ends by quoting the משנה's summary line, "וכולם אין נוטלין בשבח," and the discussion of that line continues on the next amud.

steps.title: End of the משנה: others who also cannot take from enhancement or money due
steps.stepSummary: The משנה adds the woman collecting her כתובה, daughters collecting מזונות, and the יבם to the list of people who do not collect from שבח or ראוי.
steps.simpleTranslation: Neither does a woman take these for her כתובה, nor do daughters for their מזונות, nor the יבם. None of them takes from the שבח, nor from ראוי as they do from מוחזק.
steps.whatsHappening: This is the end of the משנה. Earlier it said the בכור gets no double portion of שבח or ראוי, and now it lists three more people who share that same limit.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The rule about the בכור is being widened. A wife collecting her כתובה, daughters getting מזונות from their father's estate, and a יבם who inherits his brother's share can all collect only from what the dead man actually held. They cannot collect from value that grew after his death or from money still owed to him.

keyTerms.meaning: The marriage contract: money a wife collects at divorce or at her husband's death
Food and living support that daughters receive from their late father's estate
A man who marries his brother's widow when the brother died with no children, and takes the brother's inheritance share
Enhancement: value added to the property after the owner died
Property that was due to the dead man but that he did not yet have in hand
Property already in the owner's actual possession

steps.confusionAlert: "Like בַּמּוּחְזָק" does NOT mean they get ראוי the same way as מוחזק. It means they do NOT get ראוי the way they DO get מוחזק. They collect only from what was actually owned.

phrases.english: And not the woman for her marriage contract,
and not the daughters for their sustenance,
and not the yavam,
and all of them do not take from the enhancement
phrases.notes: Value that grew after the death

phrases.english: nor from property due, as they do from property in possession.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the earlier part of the משנה (on the previous amud) about the בכור's limits.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A כתובה, daughters' מזונות, and a יבם's inheritance are all collected only from property actually held at death, not from שבח or ראוי.

steps.title: The גמרא asks for the reason
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא opens by asking for the source of the משנה's rule that a בכור gets no double portion of his mother's estate.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא begins and asks for the reason behind the משנה's rule that a בכור gets no double portion from his mother's property. This question sets up the verse that comes next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The question points back to a clause in the משנה that appears earlier: the בכור takes a double share of his father's estate but not of his mother's. The גמרא wants a source for that difference.

keyTerms.meaning: The Talmud's discussion of the משנה
What is the reason? (asks for a source or logic)

steps.confusionAlert: "What is the reason" is not about the woman's כתובה, which was just mentioned. It refers to the earlier משנה clause about a mother's estate.

phrases.english: Gemara:
What is the reason?
phrases.notes: He's asking about the earlier ruling: no double portion from a mother's estate.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens the גמרא's analysis of the משנה.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The scriptural source showing that the בכור's double portion does not apply to a mother's estate.

steps.title: The verse limits the double portion to a father's estate
steps.stepSummary: The verse "ולו משפט הבכורה" uses "his," which teaches that בכורה is a law about a man's estate, not a woman's.
steps.simpleTranslation: The verse says, "The law of the firstborn is his." The law of the firstborn belongs to a man, and there is no law of the firstborn for a woman.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers with a verse. The word "his" ("ולו") shows that the double portion comes only from a father's estate.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The verse uses the masculine word "his" (לו). From this the גמרא learns that the duty to give the בכור a double share applies only when a man dies. When a mother dies, her sons split her estate equally.

keyTerms.meaning: The verse says (introduces a scriptural source)
The law of the firstborn: his right to a double portion
For a man

phrases.english: The verse states:
"The law of the firstborn is his" —
the law of the firstborn is for a man,
and there is no law of the firstborn for a woman.

steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: "ולו" (his) limits the בכורה law to a man's estate.

steps.title: One verse for both limits: no enhancement and no money due
steps.stepSummary: "בכל אשר ימצא לו" teaches that the בכור doubles only what was actually found with the father, which excludes both שבח and ראוי.
steps.simpleTranslation: "He does not take from the enhancement," because it is written, "of all that is found with him." "Nor from property due as from property in possession," because it is written, "of all that is found with him."
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes the next two rules of the משנה about the בכור. It gives the same verse as the source for both.
steps.deeperAnalysis: "All that is found with him" means what the father actually owned when he died. שבח did not exist yet at that time. ראוי was not in his hands yet. So the בכור takes only a regular share of both, with no double portion.

keyTerms.meaning: As it is written
That is found with him, meaning actually in his possession

steps.whatToRemember: The בכור doubles only what his father actually held at death (מוחזק). He gets no double share of a mother's estate, of שבח, or of ראוי.

phrases.english: "And he does not take in the enhancement."
Because it is written: "Of all that is found with him,"
"Nor in property due as in property possessed,"
because it is written: "Of all that is found with him."

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues giving verses for the משנה's rules about the בכור.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: "בכל אשר ימצא לו" excludes both שבח and ראוי from the double portion.

steps.title: Challenge: a creditor does collect from enhancement
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges the rule about the כתובה using שמואל's ruling that a בעל חוב collects from שבח. A wife with a כתובה is a kind of creditor.
steps.simpleTranslation: "Nor the woman for her marriage contract." Is that so? But שמואל said: a creditor collects the enhancement!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes the משנה's rule about the woman's כתובה. It then challenges it with a ruling of שמואל that seems to say the opposite.
steps.deeperAnalysis: שמואל rules that a בעל חוב can collect even from value that grew after the borrower died. A wife holding a כתובה is owed money by her husband's estate, so she seems to be a creditor too. Why, then, should she not collect from שבח?

keyTerms.meaning: Is that so? (introduces a challenge)
But didn't [he] say? (brings a contradicting statement)
Creditor
Collects payment

phrases.english: "And not the woman for her marriage contract."
Is that so? But didn't Shmuel say:
A creditor collects the enhancement!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Turns from the בכור to the next clause of the משנה, the woman's כתובה, and attacks it.
steps.kashyaTarget: The משנה's rule that a woman does not collect her כתובה from שבח.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A כתובה is a debt, and שמואל says a בעל חוב collects from שבח. So she should collect from שבח too.

steps.title: Answer: a special leniency of the marriage contract
steps.stepSummary: רבי אבא explains that the משנה is teaching one of the Sages' special leniencies for the כתובה. She is still a creditor, but in this detail her collection is more limited.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אבא said: They taught here one of the leniencies of the כתובה.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אבא answers the challenge. The כתובה has its own special leniencies, and this rule is one of them.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי אבא does not deny that a wife is a creditor. Instead, he says that the כתובה follows special lenient rules that make collection easier on the husband's estate. Not collecting from שבח is one of those rules, so שמואל's general rule for a בעל חוב stays in place.

keyTerms.meaning: Leniencies of the כתובה: special rules that limit how it is collected
They taught here

steps.whatToRemember: A regular בעל חוב collects from שבח (שמואל). A כתובה does not, because of a special leniency given to the כתובה.
steps.whyThisMatters: It shows that a כתובה is a debt, yet it does not follow every rule of a regular debt. The Sages limited how it is collected.

phrases.english: Rabbi Abba said:
They taught here one of the leniencies of the marriage contract.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַבִּי אַבָּא: מִקּוּלֵּי כְתוּבָּה שָׁנוּ כָּאן
steps.terutzResolutionType: Distinguishing the case: a special leniency of the כתובה
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Since a wife is a creditor, she should collect from שבח like any בעל חוב.
steps.terutzMaskana: She is a creditor, but the כתובה has a built-in leniency, so she does not collect from שבח. A regular בעל חוב still does.

steps.title: Why daughters' support does not include growth
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the משנה's ruling that daughters do not collect their support from שבח, and asks for the reason.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה said: 'And not the daughters for their support.' What is the reason?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes the next item in the משנה's list, the daughters who are fed from their father's estate. It asks why they cannot be fed from the growth in the estate's value.
steps.deeperAnalysis: After a man dies, his daughters are supported from his estate. The משנה says this support cannot come from שבח, meaning value that the property gained after his death. The גמרא wants to know why.

keyTerms.meaning: Support or food money. Here it means the daughters' right to be fed from their late father's estate.
'What is the reason?' The standard way the גמרא asks for the logic behind a rule.

phrases.english: And not the daughters for their support.
What is the reason?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves from the wife's כתובה (steps 5-6) to the next item in the משנה's list.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why daughters' support cannot be collected from שבח.

steps.title: A condition of the כתובה is like the כתובה
steps.stepSummary: Daughters' support is one of the תנאי כתובה, so it follows the same rule as the כתובה itself.
steps.simpleTranslation: A condition of the כתובה is like the כתובה itself.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the daughters' right to support comes from the כתובה. So it follows the כתובה's rule.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The daughters' support is one of the conditions that בית דין built into every כתובה. Step 6 taught that a כתובה is not collected from שבח. Since the support is part of the כתובה, it also cannot be collected from שבח.

keyTerms.meaning: A condition of the marriage contract, meaning an obligation that בית דין automatically includes in every כתובה.
'Is like the כתובה.' It follows the same rules.

steps.whyThisMatters: This principle, that a תנאי כתובה is treated like the כתובה, is used in many places in ש״ס.

phrases.english: A condition of the marriage contract is like the marriage contract itself.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 7 by linking back to the כתובה rule from step 6.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Daughters' support is a תנאי כתובה, and a תנאי כתובה follows the כתובה's limit on שבח.

steps.title: Why the יבם does not take growth
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the משנה's ruling that the יבם does not take שבח, and asks why.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה said: 'And not the יבם.' What is the reason?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא moves to the last person in the משנה's list, the יבם. It asks why he cannot take the growth in his dead brother's estate.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A יבם who marries his brother's widow inherits his brother's property. The משנה says he does not get the שבח. The גמרא is looking for the source of this rule.

keyTerms.meaning: The brother who marries the widow of his brother who died without children. He inherits the dead brother's estate.

phrases.english: And not the levir.
What is the reason?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves to the next item in the משנה's list.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The source for excluding the יבם from שבח.

steps.title: The Torah calls the יבם a בכור
steps.stepSummary: The Torah calls the יבם 'בכור', so he has the same limits as a בכור.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the Torah uses the word 'בכור' about the יבם. So he shares the בכור's rule.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The verse about יבום says 'והיה הבכור.' Step 4 taught that a בכור does not double the שבח. Because the Torah calls the יבם a בכור, he also does not take the שבח.

keyTerms.meaning: 'The Torah (literally, the Merciful One) called him.' This means the Torah's wording links two cases together.
Firstborn. Here it is the word the Torah uses for the יבם.

phrases.english: The Merciful One called him 'firstborn.'

steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The יבם is called בכור, so the בכור's limit on שבח applies to him.

steps.title: אביי: only growth before the יבום is excluded
steps.stepSummary: אביי limits the rule. The יבם loses only growth that happened between his brother's death and the יבום. Growth after the יבום is his.
steps.simpleTranslation: אביי said: They only taught this about growth in the property between the death and the יבום. But growth between the יבום and the division, he does take.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי narrows the משנה's rule by splitting the time into two periods. Growth before the יבום is excluded. Growth after the יבום, but before the estate is divided, goes to the יבם.
steps.deeperAnalysis: There are two time periods. The first is from the death until the יבום. The second is from the יבום until the brothers divide the estate. אביי says the משנה only excludes growth from the first period.

keyTerms.meaning: 'They only taught it about.' A formula used to narrow a rule to a specific case.
The act of the brother marrying the widow.
The division of the estate among the heirs.
'He takes.'

phrases.english: Abaye said:
They taught this only
regarding growth by which the property increased
between the death and the levirate marriage,
but growth that came between the levirate marriage and the division —
he does take.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Narrows the יבם rule from step 10.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The יבם loses only growth from before the יבום. He takes growth that came after the יבום.

steps.title: אביי's source: once he marries, he has 'stood up' for his brother
steps.stepSummary: The verse says the יבם 'shall stand in his dead brother's name.' After the יבום he has already done so.
steps.simpleTranslation: What is the reason? The Torah said, 'He shall stand up in the name of his dead brother,' and he has already stood up.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives אביי's reason from the verse. Once the יבום has happened, the יבם fully takes his brother's place.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Before the יבום, the יבם has not yet taken his brother's place. So growth from that period does not count as his. After the יבום he has 'stood up' in his brother's name. From then on, the property counts as his, so its growth is his too.

keyTerms.meaning: 'He shall stand up in the name of his brother.' The verse describing the יבם's role.
'And he has already stood up.' The יבום has already taken place.

phrases.english: What is the reason?
'He shall succeed in the name of his dead brother'
the Merciful One said,
and he has already succeeded him.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the verse that supports אביי's position in step 11.
steps.raayaObject: אביי's ruling that the יבם takes growth from after the יבום.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The verse 'יקום על שם אחיו המת' (דברים כה:ו).

steps.title: רבא: even growth after the יבום is excluded
steps.stepSummary: רבא disagrees with אביי. The יבם does not take growth even from the period between the יבום and the division.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבא said: Even growth between the יבום and the division, he also does not take.
steps.whatsHappening: רבא argues with אביי. In his view, the יבם gets no growth at all from any time before the estate is divided.
steps.deeperAnalysis: אביי ended the limit at the יבום. רבא extends it all the way to the division of the estate. So for רבא, the date of the יבום does not matter.

keyTerms.meaning: 'Even.' Signals that the rule reaches further than the other view said.
'He does not take.'

phrases.english: Rava said:
even growth that came between the levirate marriage and the division
he also does not take,

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Disagrees with אביי's limit in step 11.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The יבם takes no growth from any time before the division.

steps.title: רבא's reason: the יבם is just like a בכור
steps.stepSummary: A בכור has no extra share in growth from before the division. So the יבם, who is compared to a בכור, has none either.
steps.simpleTranslation: What is the reason? He is like a בכור. Just as a בכור has nothing extra before the division, so too a יבם has nothing extra before the division.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains רבא's view. He takes the comparison to a בכור (from step 10) all the way.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A בכור does not double any growth that comes before the estate is divided. רבא says the יבם is compared to a בכור in every way. So the cutoff is the division, not the יבום.

keyTerms.meaning: 'Just as ... so too.' The formula for comparing two cases.
'Before the division.'

steps.whatToRemember: Both sides agree that growth between the death and the יבום is excluded. אביי says the יבם takes growth after the יבום, because he has 'stood up' for his brother. רבא says he takes nothing until the division, because he is like a בכור.

phrases.english: What is the reason? He is like a firstborn:

phrases.aramaic: מָה בְּכוֹר אֵין לוֹ קוֹדֶם חֲלוּקָּה,
phrases.english: just as a firstborn has nothing before the division,
so too a levir also
has nothing before the division.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the reason for רבא's position in step 13.
steps.raayaObject: רבא's ruling that the יבם takes no growth before the division.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The Torah's comparison of the יבם to a בכור (step 10).

steps.title: The next line of the משנה: none of them take growth
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the משנה's general rule that none of the people listed take from שבח. This sets up the next discussion.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה said: 'And all of them do not take from the growth.'
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes the next phrase of the משנה, which sums up the whole list. This line is setting up the next move, which comes on the next amud.
steps.deeperAnalysis: 'All of them' means the בכור, the wife with her כתובה, the daughters with their support, and the יבם. The quote ends with a comma, so the discussion of this line continues in the next part of the daf.

keyTerms.meaning: 'And all of them.' Refers to everyone in the משנה's list.
'Take' or 'receive.'

phrases.english: And all of them do not take a portion in the growth,
phrases.notes: A quote from the משנה. The discussion continues on the next amud.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves to the משנה's next line after finishing the יבם discussion.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: None of the people listed in the משנה collect from שבח.
